CweFindings.Name: Insufficient Logging
CweFindings.Description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.
CweFindings.Explanation: The Login action processes password sign-in results, including failed attempts and lockouts, but its failure branches only return a view or add a generic model error and do not record an application audit event. The application-specific telemetry provider logs generic external-operation exceptions, not these authentication outcomes.
